publication: Immutable local manifest identity includes publishing tenant/store, template ID, version and exact content digest. Publishing activates zero stores; no automatic subscription runner exists.
acceptance: Destination-store delegation offers a manifest; a current store owner accepts the exact offer/profile revision. Current proposer permission revision must still match. Existing Profiles.put performs the local activation.
rollback: Requires the still-current accepted profile digest/revision, then writes a new increasing local revision restoring previous presentation. Other stores and all original case/approval pins remain unchanged.
protected: All policy, secrets, permissions, source, budget, profile action/data scope and skill fields are rejected as template overrides.

tests.targeted_fault: Publication mutates real Profiles for both stores immediately; the independently captured no-overwrite oracle throws.
